title: Manager, GFS Service Management
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose\-driven, world\-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.  

  

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.  

  

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance\-focused culture.**Manager \- GFS Service Management**
Hello. We’re Haleon. A new, world\-leading, and fast\-moving consumer healthcare company. Shaped by all who join us. Together, we’re improving everyday health for billions of people, by growing and innovating our global portfolio of category\-leading brands – including Crocin, Eno, Iodex, Otrivin and Centrum in India – through a unique combination of deep human understanding and trusted science. What’s more, we’re achieving it in a company that we’re in control of. In an environment that we’re cocreating. And a culture that’s uniquely ours. Care to join us. It isn’t a question.
This is an exciting time to join and help shape the future of the world’s newest and largest consumer healthcare company, that’s 100% focused on everyday health. Come and be part of something special.
Our Haleon Global Capability Centre (GCC), located in Bengaluru, India is rapidly expanding with exciting new positions being created in multiple functions.
At Haleon GCC we bring global value to our organisation, delivering complex enterprise solutions while driving digital transformation and innovation. The Finance, Digital \& Technology, HR and Procurement functions are co\-located, and work with colleagues and partners around the world. The increasing range of activities and roles based in the GCC will offer you great potential for career progression and take part in shaping the future of the GCC.**What This Role Delivers?**
The Manager, GFS Service Management, is responsible for overseeing the end\-to\-end performance, governance, and contractual compliance of Global Finance Services (GFS) outsourced partners as well as GFS operational teams. The role drives operational excellence, performance insights, vendor management, risk management and forward\-looking decision support for GFS leadership, ensuring alignment with Haleon’s strategic and operational goals.
This role also plays a critical part in strengthening service performance visibility, driving accountability across internal and external partners, and enabling continuous improvement across GFS operations.**Key Responsibilities**
In terms of the role, you can expect the GFS Service Management to undertake the following:
1\.Contract Management* Ensure successful contract execution by overseeing timely and within\-budget completion of all deliverables and proactively resolving risks or disputes.
* Serve as the single point of contact between the business and vendor for Service Management discussions.
* Own the third party Contract Change Request process and governance, ensuring clarity and adherence.
* Provide support to the GFS LT \& ELT by interpreting contractual clauses with clear business impact assessments, in partnership with Procurement
* Identify and mitigate contractual risks, ensuring full compliance.
* Review and challenge vendor KPI reporting to ensure alignment with contractual definitions and calculations.
* Drive adoption of standardised contract governance practices across regions to ensure consistency.


2\.Performance Management \& Governance* Actively review and monitor GFS performance, including Genpact performance and GFS Operational teams, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Continuously evolve GFS Management Review Boards \- refining meeting structures, inputs, and outputs.
* Support restructuring the GFS scorecard and aligning metrics with OMP (Operational Master Plan) goals.
* Drive performance conversations proactively between governance meetings.
* Ensure the new Genpact contract constructs deliver performance and productivity outcomes.
* Maintain full visibility into Genpact billings, exceptions, Change Requests, productivity, and R\&R mechanisms.
* Integrate billing, CRs, productivity, and reward mechanisms into monthly performance meetings.
* Collaborate with Contracting Lead on reviews and provoke targeted value discussions.
* Ensure stakeholders understand how to leverage contractual constructs to maximize benefits.
* Reassess KPIs quarterly or earlier if deviations persist for 3 consecutive months.
* Drive productivity assessments every 6 months with documented commitments.
* Introduce structured root‑cause analysis frameworks to strengthen operational performance insights.


3\.VOC (Voice Of Customer) monitoring* Own the VOC process including communications, distribution, consolidation, and action planning (Between BU and GFS ; between GFS and Genpact)


GFS Governance* Issue monthly GFS dashboards with root\-cause analysis and leadership\-level summaries.
* Evolve reporting from transactional to forward\-looking insights and recommendations.
* Establish standard reporting templates to ensure consistent storytelling across all service lines.

**Risk \& RAID Governance*** Manage JIRA GFS RAID access requests and maintain governance hygiene.
* Facilitate periodic risk review conversations across GFS stakeholders.

**Qualifications \& Skills*** Minimum 8 years of relevant experience
* Experience working in outsourced or hybrid operating models preferred.
* Strong analytical and commercial acumen, with the ability to translate data into insights.
* Demonstrated experience in Service Management, Vendor Management, or PMO roles within a global environment
* Demonstrate the ability to work autonomously and effectively establish and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders.
* Strong troubleshooting skills and a problem‑solving mindset.
* Capable of effectively planning for and managing multiple competing demands and priorities.
* Possesses a comprehensive understanding of steps necessary to initiate, implement, and engage in a significant organisational change effort within a matrix environment.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve results in a complex global setting and effectively solve intricate business and process challenges.
* Experience in collaborating with various internal teams and third‑party stakeholders.
* Proficient in making informed and decisive decisions.
* Ability to drive operational excellence through structured governance and performance improvement practices.
* Strong communication, vendor management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Advanced Excel, PowerBI and performance analytics capability.
* Project and change management expertise (certification preferred).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and navigate complex global ecosystems


Diversity, Equity and Inclusion
At Haleon we embrace our diverse workforce by creating an inclusive environment that celebrates our unique perspectives, generates curiosity to create unmatched understanding of each other, and promotes fair and equitable outcomes for everyone.
We’re striving to create a climate where we celebrate our diversity in all forms by treating each other with respect, listening to different viewpoints, supporting our communities, and creating a workplace where your authentic self belongs and thrives.
We believe in an agile working culture for all our roles. If flexibility is important to you, we encourage you to explore with our hiring team what the opportunities are.  

**Job Posting End Date**  


2026\-03\-31**Equal Opportunities**
-----------------------


Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It’s important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.  

  

During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees.  

  

The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.**Adjustment or Accommodations Request**
----------------------------------------


If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We’ll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.**Note to candidates**
----------------------


The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account (@haleon.com). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Hotel Manager
description:
Job Description: Hotel Manager

Position OverviewWe are looking for an experienced, dynamic Hotel Manager to lead the overall operations of our \[3\-5 star / boutique / luxury] hotel. As the key leader on property, you will be responsible for delivering exceptional guest experiences, driving operational efficiency, maximizing revenue, and building a high\-performing team. This is a hands\-on leadership role that demands strong business acumen, people skills, and a passion for hospitality.

Key Responsibilities

* Oversee all hotel departments (Front Office, Housekeeping, Food \& Beverage, Sales, Maintenance, Finance, and HR) and ensure seamless day\-to\-day operations.
* Lead, motivate, and develop a team of 50–150\+ associates; conduct performance reviews, training programs, and succession planning.
* Deliver outstanding guest satisfaction scores (TripAdvisor, Google, internal surveys) and personally resolve escalated guest issues.
* Drive revenue through dynamic pricing, upselling strategies, corporate contracts, events, and banquet sales in coordination with the Sales \& Revenue team.
* Manage operating budgets, control costs (payroll, supplies, utilities), and achieve or exceed monthly and annual financial targets (RevPAR, GOP, ADR).
* Maintain the highest standards of cleanliness, safety, security, and compliance with local health, fire, and licensing regulations.
* Develop and execute annual marketing and business plans in collaboration with ownership or corporate office.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, travel agents, OTA partners, and local community stakeholders.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and guest feedback to recommend service and product improvements.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly management reports for ownership/corporate leadership.

Requirements \& QualificationsEducation

* Bachelor’s degree in Hotel Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or equivalent (Master’s preferred).

Experience

* Minimum 5–8 years of progressive hotel experience with at least 2–3 years as Hotel Manager or Assistant General Manager in a 50\+ room property.
* Proven track record in revenue management, cost control, and team leadership.

Skills \& Competencies

* Strong leadership and people\-management skills with ability to inspire teams.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills (fluency in English \+ local language required).
* Proficient in Opera / Fidelio, PMS, POS systems, and Microsoft Office (especially Excel).
* Solid understanding of financial statements (P\&L, budgets, forecasting).
* High emotional intelligence and crisis\-management ability.
* Guest\-obsessed mindset with a hands\-on “roll\-up\-the\-sleeves” attitude.

Preferred

* Experience with international hotel brands (IHG, Marriott, Hilton, Accor, etc.).
* Certification in revenue management, food safety, or hospitality leadership programs.
* Working knowledge of labor laws and union environments (if applicable).

What We Offer

* Competitive salary \+ performance bonus (up to 20–30% of annual CTC).
* Comprehensive benefits package (health insurance, accommodation/meals, transport, gratuity).
* Career growth opportunities within the group.
* Free meals while on duty and uniform.
* Dynamic work environment in a fast\-growing hospitality company.

Reporting LineReports directly to: Owner / Regional Director / Area General Manager

If you are a results\-driven hospitality professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment and loves creating memorable guest experiences, we want to hear from you!

How to ApplyPlease send your updated resume and current salary details to \[email] with the subject line: “Hotel Manager Application – \[Your Name]”.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity.*

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹60,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: In person

title: Mechanical Engineering
description:
Mechanical engineers are versatile professionals who research, design, develop, build, and test mechanical and thermal systems, ranging from micro\-scale sensors to massive industrial machinery. Their core responsibility is to bridge the gap between scientific principles (like physics and math) and practical applications to solve real\-world problems. Bureau of Labor Statistics (.gov) \+3**Core Responsibilities**The day\-to\-day duties of a mechanical engineer typically follow the full product lifecycle: Workable \+1

* **Design \& Modeling**: Creating 3D CAD (Computer\-Aided Design) models and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings using tools like SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Creo, or Inventor.
* **Analysis \& Simulation**: Performing Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to test stress, heat transfer, and fluid flow before physical production.
* **Prototyping \& Testing**: Developing physical prototypes (often using 3D printing or CNC machining) and conducting methodical experiments to validate performance and safety.
* **Manufacturing Oversight**: Collaborating with production teams to oversee the fabrication process, ensuring designs are manufacturable (DFM) and meet quality standards.
* **Maintenance \& Troubleshooting**: Investigating equipment failures, performing root cause analysis, and recommending design modifications to prevent future malfunctions. Workable \+9

**Required Skills \& Qualifications** Employers typically look for a mix of deep technical knowledge and "soft" collaborative skills:

* **Education**: A **Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering** is the standard entry\-level requirement. A Master's degree is often preferred for specialized R\&D roles.
* **Technical Proficiency**: Strong grasp of thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, materials science, and kinematics.
* **Software Skills**: Proficiency in CAD/CAM/CAE software and mathematical computing tools like MATLAB or Excel.
* **Soft Skills**: Problem\-solving, analytical thinking, creativity, and the ability to communicate complex technical data to non\-technical stakeholders. Betterteam \+8

**Typical Work Environment**

* **Setting**: Primarily office\-based for design and analysis, with frequent visits to factories, workshops, or building sites to inspect equipment and oversee installations.
* **Collaboration**: Working in multidisciplinary teams alongside electrical engineers, project managers, software developers, and manufacturing personnel. Bureau of Labor Statistics (.gov) \+4

**Common Specialisations** Mechanical engineering roles can vary significantly by industry: The University of Virginia \+1

* **Automotive Engineer**: Designing vehicle systems, engines, and aerodynamics.
* **Aerospace Engineer**: Developing aircraft, spacecraft, and propulsion systems.
* **HVAC Engineer**: Designing heating, ventilation, and air conditioning systems for buildings.
* **Robotics Engineer**: Designing automated systems and robotic instruments.
* **Manufacturing/Process Engineer**: Optimising production lines and industrial workflows. Bureau of Labor Statistics (.gov) \+6

title: PCB Design Engineer
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a versatile **CAD Engineer** to lead the physical design and layout of our advanced controller boards. You will be responsible for the full PCB lifecycle—from footprint creation to generating manufacturing\-ready Gerber/ODB\+\+ packages. The ideal candidate is a "power user" in **Altium Designer** for complex, high\-speed projects and is equally proficient in **KiCad** for agile, open\-hardware, or rapid\-prototyping initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Dual\-Platform Layout:** Execute high\-density, multi\-layer (4–10\+ layers) PCB designs in **Altium** and **KiCad**, selecting the best tool based on project requirements.
* **High\-Speed Routing:** Implement controlled impedance, differential pairs, and length\-matching for high\-speed buses (USB 2\.0/3\.0, SPI, and memory interfaces).
* **Library Management:** Build and maintain centralized component libraries (symbols, 3D STEP models, and footprints) compliant with **IPC\-7351** standards across both platforms.
* **Signal \& Power Integrity:** Perform basic SI/PI analysis to minimize crosstalk, EMI, and power\-rail noise, especially around sensitive **RFID/NFC frontends**.
* **DFM/DFA/DFT:** Conduct thorough **Design for Manufacturing** and **Assembly** reviews to ensure high yields and lower production costs at EMS providers.
* **MCAD Collaboration:** Coordinate with mechanical engineers to ensure PCB\-to\-Enclosure fitment using **Altium 365** or **KiCad’s STEP export** features.

**Technical Skills \& Qualifications**

* **EDA Expertise:** 6 months of experience with **Altium Designer** (Unified environment, ActiveBOM) and **KiCad** (Version 7\.0/8\.0\).
* **PCB Technology:** Expertise in **HDI (High\-Density Interconnect)**, micro\-vias, and complex layer stack\-up definitions.
* **RF Awareness:** Familiarity with PCB antenna design and isolation techniques for **NXP RFID/NFC** chipsets.
* **Standards:** Strong knowledge of **IPC\-2221** (Design) and **IPC\-610** (Acceptability).
* **Version Control:** Proficiency in using **Git** for managing KiCad project files and **Altium 365** for cloud\-based versioning.

title: freelance wordpress developer
description:
1\. Position Overview

The WordPress Developer will be a part of the web development team and will assist in the design, development, customization, optimization, and maintenance of WordPress\-based websites and applications. This internship is designed to provide hands\-on, real\-world experience in WordPress development while working under the guidance of experienced developers and project managers.

The intern will gain exposure to modern web development practices, content management systems (CMS), front\-end and back\-end development concepts, website performance optimization, security best practices, and collaborative software development workflows. This role is ideal for students or recent graduates who are passionate about web technologies and eager to build a strong foundation in WordPress development.

2\. Key Objectives of the Internship

* To provide practical experience in developing and managing WordPress websites
* To help interns understand real\-world project workflows and development lifecycles
* To build technical competence in WordPress core, themes, plugins, and customization
* To develop problem\-solving, debugging, and optimization skills
* To enhance collaboration and communication skills within a professional development team

3\. Roles and Responsibilities3\.1 WordPress Development

* Assist in building, customizing, and maintaining WordPress websites based on project requirements
* Work with WordPress themes (both pre\-built and custom themes) to implement UI/UX designs
* Customize WordPress plugins and develop basic custom plugins when required
* Support the integration of third\-party tools, APIs, and plugins
* Implement responsive design principles to ensure compatibility across devices and browsers

3\.2 Front\-End Development Support

* Write clean, well\-structured HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript code
* Assist in converting design mockups (Figma, Adobe XD, PSD) into functional WordPress pages
* Optimize website layouts for performance, usability, and accessibility
* Make UI enhancements based on user feedback and testing results

3\.3 Back\-End and CMS Support

* Assist in configuring WordPress core settings, custom post types, taxonomies, and fields
* Support PHP\-based WordPress customization tasks under supervision
* Help manage databases (MySQL) related to WordPress installations
* Participate in content migration, data imports, and backups

3\.4 Website Performance and Optimization

* Assist in optimizing website speed and performance using caching, image optimization, and best practices
* Identify and resolve basic performance bottlenecks
* Support SEO\-friendly development practices such as clean URLs, schema markup, and metadata integration

3\.5 Security and Maintenance

* Assist in implementing WordPress security best practices
* Help update WordPress core, themes, and plugins while ensuring site stability
* Monitor websites for common vulnerabilities and issues
* Participate in routine maintenance tasks and quality assurance testing

3\.6 Testing and Debugging

* Conduct functional, UI, and cross\-browser testing
* Identify bugs, errors, and inconsistencies and assist in resolving them
* Use debugging tools and browser developer tools to troubleshoot issues
* Document issues clearly for senior developers

3\.7 Collaboration and Documentation

* Work closely with designers, developers, content creators, and project managers
* Participate in daily or weekly stand\-ups, sprint meetings, and project discussions
* Maintain clear documentation for development tasks, changes, and workflows
* Follow coding standards, version control practices, and internal development guidelines

4\. Required Skills and Technical Knowledge4\.1 Core Technical Skills

* Basic to intermediate understanding of WordPress CMS
* Familiarity with WordPress themes, plugins, and dashboard functionality
* Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, and basic JavaScript
* Basic understanding of PHP and how it is used in WordPress
* Familiarity with MySQL databases and CMS\-driven websites

4\.2 Tools and Technologies

* WordPress (latest versions)
* Code editors such as VS Code, Sublime Text, or similar
* Version control systems (Git/GitHub or GitLab – basic knowledge preferred)
* Page builders such as Elementor, Gutenberg, or WPBakery (optional but advantageous)

4\.3 Soft Skills

* Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Attention to detail and commitment to quality work
* Ability to follow instructions and meet deadlines
* Good communication skills (written and verbal)
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment

5\. Educational Qualifications

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree or diploma in:
* Computer Science
* Information Technology
* Web Development
* Software Engineering
* Or a related technical field
* Candidates from non\-technical backgrounds with demonstrable WordPress and web development skills are also encouraged to apply

6\. Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

* Prior experience with WordPress projects (academic, freelance, or personal)
* Basic knowledge of SEO concepts and digital marketing integration
* Familiarity with REST APIs and third\-party integrations
* Understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG)
* Exposure to hosting environments, cPanel, or cloud hosting platforms

7\. Learning Outcomes and Growth Opportunities

By the end of the internship, the WordPress Developer Intern is expected to:

* Gain hands\-on experience in developing and managing live WordPress websites
* Understand professional development workflows and best practices
* Build a strong portfolio of WordPress\-based projects
* Improve coding, debugging, and optimization skills
* Develop confidence in working with clients, stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams

High\-performing interns may be considered for:

* Internship extension
* Part\-time or full\-time WordPress Developer roles
* Advanced responsibilities on client and internal projects

8\. Performance Evaluation Criteria

Intern performance will be evaluated based on:

* Quality and accuracy of assigned development tasks
* Ability to learn and apply new concepts
* Adherence to timelines and instructions
* Communication and teamwork
* Problem\-solving and initiative

Regular feedback sessions will be conducted to support continuous improvement.

9\. Work Environment and Culture

* Collaborative and learning\-focused work environment
* Mentorship from experienced developers and technical leads
* Exposure to real\-world client projects and deadlines
* Encouragement of innovation, experimentation, and skill development
* Professional standards of conduct, confidentiality, and accountability

10\. Internship Benefits

* Hands\-on industry experience in WordPress development
* Certificate of Internship upon successful completion
* Letter of Recommendation or performance\-based referral (where applicable)
* Opportunity to work on real projects for real clients
* Flexible working hours (subject to organizational policy)
* Potential pre\-placement offer based on performance

11\. Application Process

Interested candidates should submit:

* Updated resume/CV
* Portfolio or links to WordPress projects (if available)
* A brief statement of interest explaining why they want to pursue a WordPress Developer Internship

Shortlisted candidates may be required to complete:

* A basic technical assessment
* An interview (technical and/or HR)

The Akanksha Foundation is a non\-profit organization with a mission to provide children from low\-income communities with a high\-quality education, enabling them to maximize their potential and transform their lives. Akanksha works primarily in the field of education, addressing formal education by initiating school reform through its School Project. Currently, Akanksha reaches out to the 13000\+ children through its 26 schools in Mumbai, Pune and Nagpur.

**Position:** Primary Teacher (English, SST)

You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. You will build strong bonds with children to understand each child’s needs and work with parents as partners in their child’s education and future. Overview of the Team: The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai and Pune. These schools work in partnership with local municipalities, with the vision of creating small clusters of model schools in these cities that can be used to impact the mainstream education system. The School Team comprises teachers, social workers, school administrator and helpers led by the School Leader.

**What your role will entail:**

● Teaching the Akanksha curriculum through effective pedagogical practices

● Designing and executing lesson plans that will engage students

● Designing assessments that thoughtfully evaluate student progress

● Varying teaching strategies and styles to meet different learning needs

● Providing a positive environment to engage students in the learning process

**Project \& Deployment Support**

* Proven experience in team handling or mentoring.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Certifications such as CCNA / CCNP or equivalent.

* Network uptime and availability.
* Incident resolution time (MTTR).
* SLA compliance.
* Team productivity and performance.
* Successful delivery of network projects.

**Key Responsibilities** 




**Documentation Ownership \& Strategy** 



* Own the end\-to\-end documentation lifecycle for Exxat products: planning, authoring, reviewing, publishing, and governance.
* Build and maintain documentation frameworks, templates, style guides, and best practices.
* Define and track documentation KPIs such as adoption, reduction in support tickets, content freshness, and usability feedback.



**Product Documentation \& Enablement** 



* Develop and maintain high\-quality user guides, admin guides, and online help systems.
* Create configuration and setup guides that serve as the central reference for onboarding and implementation.
* Produce troubleshooting playbooks to enable Support teams to resolve issues independently.
* Deliver clear, accurate, and consistent release notes for every product release.



**Multimedia \& Modern Content Delivery** 



* Create customer\-friendly content formats, including:
* Tutorial videos and short walkthroughs
* Step\-by\-step product tutorials
* FAQs, quick\-start guides, and cheat sheets
* In\-app inline help, tooltips, and context\-sensitive guidance
* Collaborate with SMEs to convert complex workflows into visual, easy\-to\-consume learning assets.



**Collaboration \& Cross\-functional Alignment** 



* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, SMEs, Support, Customer Success, and Implementation teams to gather requirements and validate content.
* Review and approve UX microcopy, including validation messages, confirmations, announcements, and menu labels.
* Ensure documentation stays aligned with product behavior, releases, and the business roadmap.



**Mentorship \& Leadership** 



* Mentor junior writers or contribute to building a scalable documentation team.
* Review documentation created by others and provide feedback on quality, structure, clarity, tone, and completeness.
* Drive initiatives such as content audits, documentation refactoring, taxonomy cleanup, and consistency programs.



**Tools \& Process Improvement** 



* Evaluate and recommend documentation tools (knowledge bases, help authoring tools, video creation tools, content analytics).
* Establish workflows for version control, review cycles, publishing cadence, and long\-term maintenance.



  





**Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.







**Required Skills** 



* 9\+ years of experience in technical writing, product documentation, or online help content.
* Strong ability to write clear, structured, procedural documentation with clean formatting and screenshots.
* Comfortable working with technical audiences and complex workflows.
* Proven experience managing documentation end\-to\-end across multiple stakeholders.
* Strong ownership mindset — planning, prioritization, execution, and long\-term maintenance.
* Hands\-on exposure to multimedia content such as tutorials, videos, walkthroughs, and short\-form product education.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and review skills.



  





**Good to Have** 



* Experience leading a small documentation team or mentoring junior writers.
* Experience with in\-app guidance tools (walkthrough builders, tooltip frameworks).
* Prior documentation experience in B2B SaaS or enterprise products.
* Familiarity with structured authoring concepts, including reusable content, taxonomy, and content governance.

title: Talent Acq Analyst
description:
Overview:

As a member of PepsiCo’s Global Talent Acquisition Organization based In Hyderabad, India the TA Partner is responsible for developing and executing against the talent acquisition strategy with a primary focus on the management of full life cycle recruiting for global roles.
Responsibilities:
* Provide sound staffing support for identified vacancies, with a goal of filling open roles with qualified internal or external talent while achieving target metrics such as Time to Accept(TTA), Time\-to\-Find/Hire, Hiring Manager Satisfaction scores(HMSS) and system accuracy, among others.
* Execute the full life cycle recruitment process for each requisition including:
* Facilitation of Recruitment Strategy Meeting including presenting relevant Market Intelligence along with prepared data to align on service level agreement.
* Ensure timely and effective communications between candidate(s) and hiring managers.
* Develop Sourcing Strategy with strong emphasis on leveraging creative tools to identify passive talent (i.e. Linked In, employee referrals, Social media, etc.) for both current and future pipeline needs.
* Screen, assess, and evaluate internal and external candidates and present qualified candidate slate to Hiring Managers. Candidate slate representation should meet Diversity and Talent requirements established.
* Work closely with TA Operations to ensure seamless candidate experience.
* Manage candidate feedback efficiently and in a timely manner.
* Present final offer to candidate and manage offer negotiations when necessary.
* Develop and maintain strong working relationships with multiple stakeholders, including functional hiring managers, senior leadership team members, and HR partners in order to foster partnerships that yield consistent on\-going communication, high\-quality results, and efficient processes in order to build TA function credibility.
* Ensure process adherence and system accuracy as aligned for TA Service Delivery.
* Communicate and educate clients on the staffing policies and processes for both internal mobility and external selection
* Develop the ability to effectively communicate PepsiCo’s compelling employment proposition by presenting candidates with information related to: PepsiCo’s culture, leadership model, function\-specific career path model and the employment brand.
* Drive data driven and market informed conversations with stakeholders influencing hiring decisions to hire the best talent for PepsiCo.


Qualifications:
* Undergraduate College Degree/ B Degree/First degree is required
* A minimum of 7 years of relevant professional experience. Previous experience with high\-volume, full\-lifecycle Talent Acquisition/Staffing experience for executive hires is required. Previous agency or search firm experience is also relevant and will be considered.
* Proficient in full suite of Microsoft products: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook
* Prior experience and proficiency in working with iCIMS or another Candidate Management System/Applicant Tracking System
* Familiarity and experience in utilizing social media as a means by which to attract talent.
* Prior work experience within another FMCG or manufacturing organization and/or within another large, global, matrix environment
* Proven ability to influence internal clients/hiring teams on staffing\-related decisions, providing a value adding point of view relative to candidate consideration and organizational need
* Displays a strong level of professional maturity and track record of developing strong client partnerships
* Personable, high energy individual that is passionate about recruitment and enjoys working in a fast paced, innovative, dynamic organization
* Must be collaborative team player
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism at all times.

title: Sr. Manager Training
description:
**Description**  

**Sr. Manager Training**  

The Senior Manager Training is accountable in driving overall Training Performance across all assigned accounts. This position owns the effectiveness, efficiency, consistency of ResultsCX’s client training processes and initiatives within the Account Training span of control. Sr. Manager Training partners with Operations to provide necessary training intervention on performance gaps while coming up both short\-term to long\-term delivery plans to ensure strategies and tactics are executed against timelines, resources, process guidelines, competency requirements and expectations of Results and our partners.


**Role Requires: Onsite work, previous contact center, training, and healthcare vertical experience.**

  




**In this role you will:**  

* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* Provide strategic support to Account Training Managers/Account Training Specialist and tactical support to Executives within the Training organization
* Identify the whole Account Training organization’s needs in staffing, budget, and general support, and creates/provides recommended solutions
* Be a global leader responsible in managing ResultsCX and clients’ training operations model/process and expectations and represents ResultsCX Training Team in both Operations senior leadership and client\-facing opportunities.
* Track, analyze, and report training effectiveness through agent life cycle performance: New Hire, Grad School and 0\-30 productions
* Communicate data\-driven findings, feedback, recommendations using multiple data references such as but not limited to attrition report, training satisfaction report, trainer observation and coaching report, training dashboard, QA report.
* Recommend necessary training intervention based on identified gaps which include but not be limited to training program content, bridge plans, governance steps, measured through improved class throughput, learner engagement, operations performance, and overall speed to proficiency
* Implement best in class training principles and methodologies in improving learning experience of New Hires from classroom training to grad school and operations through curriculum development, learning methodologies, grad school/learning lab playbook and training tools/technologies
* Partner with the Site Training Operations team and HR to create developmental programs for Trainers and Training staff
* Update program/site/region leadership and stakeholders on key strategic initiatives by building effective communication rhythms, strong partnership and client\-value add positioned for business growth
* Provide reviews and readouts showcasing impact of training\-led projects and initiatives (Effectively assess specific Success Measures prior to launching any training intervention, align with stakeholders on expected ROI, comprehensive readouts of post\-training impacts from the agreed upon Success Measures)
* Lead and represent training during launches and through effective project management, establishing communication channels, resource management, building travel plans and ensure effective partnership with other functional areas.
* Facilitate transformational learning solutions by applying world class learning principles and instructional design methodologies that drive success and effectiveness of training in all levels of evaluation: increased learning retention, improved learning experience, increase throughput, elevated performance, and improved overall speed to proficiency
* Develop existing leaderships (ATMs/ATS) and other high potential leaders by fostering their professional growth through regular coaching and feedback, certification, and immersions
* Champion training development programs and initiatives through client certifications, leadership programs, training observations, teach back, regular coaching and feedback while coming up with Performance Management Plan for direct reports to address performance gaps/opportunities
* Process governance of the overall training operating model which includes, ATM/ATS hiring and selection, onboarding processes, agent cycle handoffs, learning agreement, Daily Engagement Journals, certification process, Olympian travel, grad school playbook and training audits.
* Curriculum / Instructional Design audit and creation (Instructional design techniques, effective eLearning evaluation and design, utilization of virtual training creation platforms, appropriately assess training intervention strategy and appropriate design platform and implementation)

**We are looking for someone who has:**  

* Two or more years of successful management of training team (training delivery, instructional design, strategy)
* Experience with business process design/improvement, including gathering requirements, documenting workflows, and developing specifications.
* Advanced knowledge of Adult Learning Principles, Kirkpatrick’s Levels of Training Evaluation, and Instructional Methodologies. Degree preferred.
* Superior consulting skills, (e.g., critical thinking, problem solving, decision making, and influencing)
* Strong organization skills and ability to multi\-task in a dynamic, fast paced environment
* Ability to creatively use resources and adjust to changes quickly and professionally
* Ability to analyze data for trends and able to recognize opportunities for improvement both short\-term and long\-term
* Experience developing people and running teams
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, but also in a team environment
* Superb attention to details specially in the area of Project management of big to medium initiatives and projects
* Ability to provide on\-call support
* Strong relationship building skills with internal and external clients/ stakeholders
* Schedule flexibility (travel required both local and international)


Preferred Education and Experience


* Experience at ResultsCX
* Are of expertise on client\-specific training and requirements
* Knowledge of common analytics practices is a plus (Six Sigma)
* Instructional design certification

**About ResultsCX:**  

ResultsCX is a premier customer experience partner to Fortune 100 and 500 companies. We design, build, and deliver digitally influenced customer journeys that achieve the satisfaction and loyalty brands need to thrive and grow, while improving efficiency and reducing costs. ResultsCX’s 30\+\-year track record for reimagining the customer experience to meet consumers’ evolving expectations has driven growth to more than 20 geographic hubs and approximately 20,000 colleagues worldwide. Our core expertise extends to actionable analytics, contact center as a service (CCaaS), and our own SupportPredict AI\-powered digital experience platform. Our strength lies in exceptional individuals working together in a high\-performing, fun culture to deliver next\-generation customer experiences on behalf of our clients.

description:
Overview:

This role needs someone who can run a high\-performing TA team while still staying close to the business by owning a slate of senior and critical mandates. You’ll steer stakeholder alignment, enforce process discipline, raise the bar on candidate quality, and shape how the function shows up across markets.
Responsibilities:
* Lead, coach, and develop a TA team that delivers consistently and grows in capability.
* Manage end\-to\-end hiring for senior and hard\-to\-fill roles, including market mapping, direct sourcing, and offer strategy.
* Partner with global and regional leaders to understand business priorities and convert them into sharp hiring plans.

* Shape talent attraction initiatives with insights on competitor talent, market realities, and messaging that resonates.
* Push continuous improvement across recruiting tools, systems, and stakeholder experience.

* 10\+ years of strong Talent Acquisition experience across complex, high\-growth environments.
* Strong experience leading recruiters in a fast\-moving, multi\-market setup.
* A track record of closing senior and niche roles through direct sourcing.
* Confident stakeholder management at Director and VP levels.
* Ability to coach, inspire, and raise performance across a team.
* Strong grip on data, hiring metrics, and operational rigor.
* Strong understanding of the latest hiring tools and techniques including AI\-driven sourcing.
* Someone who thrives in ambiguity and keeps the team focused on outcomes.

* Generate data\-driven reports to provide insights and recommendations for recruitment improvements.

* Identify bottlenecks and recruitment inefficiencies, define actionable solutions for improvement with Global H2O Process team.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
* **We deliver the world’s most complex projects.**
* **Work as part of a collaborative and inclusive team.**
* **Enjoy a varied \& challenging role.**

  

**Building on our past. Ready for the future**

Worley is a global professional services company of energy, chemicals and resources experts headquartered in Australia.


Right now, we’re bridging two worlds as we accelerate to more sustainable energy sources, while helping our customers provide the energy, chemicals and resources that society needs now.


We partner with our customers to deliver projects and create value over the life of their portfolio of assets. We solve complex problems by finding integrated data\-centric solutions from the first stages of consulting and engineering to installation and commissioning, to the last stages of decommissioning and remediation. Join us and help drive innovation and sustainability in our projects.  



  

**The Role**

***As Talent Acquisition Specialist with Worley*** , you will work closely with our existing team to deliver projects for our clients while continuing to develop your skills and experience etc.


The Global Talent Acquisition Operations Partner will play a critical role in supporting and optimizing the operational facets of our Talent Acquisition (TA) function. This role will work closely with Regional TA Directors, TA Delivery teams, and global stakeholders to support and deliver key initiatives. This includes overseeing technology platforms, processes, training programs, vendor relationships, risk and compliance, privacy, and data integrity. The individual in this role will ensure seamless integration and continuous improvement of recruitment technologies and processes, while driving operational efficiency and ensuring global consistency and compliance.


* **Talent Acquisition Technology \& Systems Management:**
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to identify, optimize, and streamline the use of talent acquisition technology platforms (ATS, CRM, AI tools, job boards, staffing agencies, background check vendors, etc.) to gather insights and drive global and regional improvements in our TA tech stack and recruitment processes.
* **Process Management \& Continuous Improvement** :
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to develop, document, and refine regional talent acquisition processes ensuring consistency, efficiency, and alignment with global recruitment standards and practices.
	+ Develop continuous improvement recommendations using data insights, stakeholder feedback, and market best practices, to inform work and prioritization of improvement initiatives, applying modern and lean design principles.
	+ Partner with key stakeholders to lead and support initiatives focused on continuous process improvements aimed at enhancing overall end\-user experience, with a concentrated focus on candidate experience, hiring manager satisfaction, and recruiter productivity.
* **Project Management: Implementations \& Enhancements:**
	+ Support global projects and initiatives projects, in alignment with the Regional TA Director and Regional TA Delivery team to support the design, implementation, and optimization of new systems, tools, and processes that increase efficiency within the talent acquisition function.
	  
	
	Manage and deliver system upgrades, enhancements, and integrations to minimize disruptions and ensure high adoption rates, while measuring.
* **Vendor \& Supplier Management:**
	+ Support vendor relationships with external recruitment vendors, staffing agencies, job boards, and other third\-party suppliers, with input from Regional TA Delivery to inform desired outcomes and organizational priorities.
	+ Investigate and resolve TA vendor\-related inquiries and disputes.
* **Privacy, Compliance, \& Risk Management:**
	+ Support initiatives to assess, measure, manage, and mitigate risks associated with hiring processes, technologies, and vendor partnerships.
	  
	
	Partner with key stakeholders to lead and support process and performance audits to ensure data accuracy, efficiency, adoption, and utilization of TA processes and technology.
* **Training \& Development:**
	+ Provide ongoing training related to technology, compliance, and recruitment best practices.
* **Issue Resolution \& Support:**
	+ Serve as the primary point of contact for resolving any issues related to talent acquisition operations, such as system errors, vendor disputes, and/or process inefficiencies.
	+ Work cross\-functionally with the Regional TA Delivery teams to address operational challenges and provide timely, effective solutions to TA Operations, Digital, and Process Teams.

**About You**

To be considered for this role it is envisaged you will possess the following attributes:


* A minimum of 3 years’ experience successfully leading process assessments, audits, and continuous improvement efforts in Talent Acquisition.
* A minimum of 2 years; experience supporting or leading the design and implementation of AI systems and tools, driving process optimization and adoption.
* Strong knowledge of global compliance regulations, data privacy laws, and risk management practices within the recruitment space.
* Experience managing vendor relationships, contract negotiations, and/or third\-party service agreements.
* Project management skills with the ability to oversee multiple initiatives and drive them to successful completion.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels.
* Advanced data analysis and interpretation skills to derive insights from data and convert them into recommendations for improvement.
* Proven track record of leading and implementing process improvements, technology upgrades, and training initiatives.
* Experience designing and/or implementing Eightfold.
* Experience with ATS system design and management.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
* Prior experience in recruitment.

**Moving forward together**

We want our people to be energized and empowered to drive sustainable impact. So, our focus is on a values\-inspired culture that unlocks brilliance through belonging, connection and innovation.


We’re building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. Creating a space where everyone feels they belong, can be themselves, and are heard.


And we're not just talking about it; we're doing it. We're reskilling our people, leveraging transferable skills, and supporting the transition of our workforce to become experts in today's low carbon energy infrastructure and technology.


Whatever your ambition, there’s a path for you here. And there’s no barrier to your potential career success. Join us to broaden your horizons, explore diverse opportunities, and be part of delivering sustainable change.


Worley takes personal data protection seriously and respects EU and local data protection laws. You can read our full Recruitment Privacy Notice Here .


Please note: If you are being represented by a recruitment agency you will not be considered, to be considered you will need to apply directly to Worley.

title: HR Manager
description:
**Company Overview**

Cyberchrome Private Limited is a fast\-growing IT and business development company focused on building structured, scalable systems for startups and premium clients. We specialize in business development solutions, digital infrastructure, and strategic growth support.

We are transitioning from a local service model to a **premium client\-focused organization**, and we are looking for a strong HR leader to build and manage a professional workforce system.

**Skills**

* Strong leadership and decision\-making ability
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Deep understanding of organizational structure and HR systems
* Ability to handle pressure and enforce discipline
* Strategic thinking \+ execution capability

**Role Objective**

The HR Head will be responsible for designing, implementing, and managing the entire HR system of Cyberchrome. This role is focused on building a **structured, disciplined, and performance\-driven team culture** aligned with business growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

1\. HR System Development

* Design and implement complete HR policies and SOPs
* Build a structured organizational hierarchy (Team Leaders, Departments, Reporting flow)
* Develop employee lifecycle systems (Hiring → Onboarding → Performance → Exit)
* Ensure the company operates in a **system\-driven structure, not person\-dependent**

2\. Recruitment \& Talent Acquisition

* Plan and execute hiring strategies for all departments
* Create job descriptions and hiring pipelines
* Conduct interviews and shortlist high\-quality candidates
* Focus on hiring **growth\-oriented and disciplined professionals**

3\. Performance Management System

* Implement KPI\-based performance tracking
* Monitor employee productivity and efficiency
* Coordinate with team leaders for performance reviews
* Develop reward, incentive, and penalty systems

4\. Employee Discipline \& Culture

* Maintain strict professional communication systems
* Ensure no direct dependency between employees and top management (structured communication only through team leaders)
* Build a **high\-performance, no\-nonsense work culture**
* Handle employee conflicts and disciplinary actions

5\. Training \& Development

* Identify skill gaps and organize training programs
* Develop onboarding training systems for new employees
* Improve team productivity through continuous learning

6\. Payroll \& Compliance

* Manage salary structures, attendance, and leave systems
* Ensure compliance with labor laws and company policies
* Coordinate with accounts for payroll processing

7\. HR Analytics \& Reporting

* Track hiring metrics, employee performance, and retention rates
* Provide regular reports to management
* Suggest improvements based on data

title: Business Consulting - Product Owner - Data Platform (Incentive Compensation / Varicent Program)
description:
**Req ID:** 363102
  

  

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward\-thinking organization, apply now.  

  

We are currently seeking a Business Consulting \- Product Owner \- Data Platform (Incentive Compensation / Varicent Program) to join our team in Chennai, Tamil Nādu (IN\-TN), India (IN).  

  

**Job Description:**  

  

**Role Overview**  

  

We are seeking an experienced **Product Owner \- Data Platform** with strong domain expertise in **Incentive Compensation Planning (ICP)** to drive product strategy, roadmap execution, and value realization for the enterprise Data Platform supporting the Varicent program.  

  

This role will ensure the data platform reliably powers complex compensation processes including:  

* Sales crediting and adjustments
* Hierarchy management
* Quota and territory alignment
* Incentive plan modeling
* Earnings and payout calculations
* Retro adjustments and clawbacks
* Audit, traceability, and compliance

  

The ideal candidate combines **deep ICP business understanding** with experience in **modern cloud\-based data platforms, Medallion architecture, Data Vault modeling, and governed data exposure strategies**.  

  

**Key Responsibilities**  

  

**1\. Product Vision \& ICP\-Aligned Strategy**  

* Define and own the **Data Platform product vision** aligned to enterprise Incentive Compensation strategy.
* Ensure the platform supports:
* + Accurate and timely compensation calculations
	+ Full auditability and lineage for payout traceability
	+ Scenario modeling and simulation needs
	+ Secure handling of sensitive compensation data
* Build and maintain a multi\-quarter roadmap covering:
* + ICP data ingestion and transformation pipelines
	+ Medallion architecture maturity (Bronze/Silver/Gold layers)
	+ Data Vault implementation for compensation entities
	+ Secure and scalable data exposure for Varicent and downstream systems
* Prioritize initiatives based on business impact (e.g., payout accuracy, cycle time reduction, dispute reduction).

  

**2\. ICP Data Domain Ownership**  

  

Act as the product authority for compensation\-related data domains, including:  

* Sales transactions \& bookings
* Crediting rules \& split logic
* Sales hierarchies and territory structures
* Quotas \& targets
* Incentive plan definitions
* Earnings \& payout calculations
* Adjustments, clawbacks, and disputes
* Historical compensation audit data

  

Ensure data models and transformations support:  

* Retroactive recalculations
* Period\-based compensation cycles
* Versioned plan structures
* Hierarchy changes over time
* Regulatory and financial compliance requirements

  

Collaborate closely with Data Architects to ensure Data Vault modeling properly represents ICP business keys (e.g., employee, plan, position, territory, transaction).  

  

**3\. Backlog Ownership \& Delivery Execution**  

* Own and manage the **Data Platform backlog** across:
* + Compensation data ingestion pipelines (batch \& streaming)
	+ Data validation and reconciliation frameworks
	+ Data quality rules specific to ICP logic
	+ Lakehouse architecture enablement (Databricks/Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift)
	+ Secure data access models (RBAC for sensitive compensation data)
* Write clear epics and user stories translating ICP requirements into technical deliverables.
* Ensure each feature supports:
* + Traceability
	+ Reproducibility of payouts
	+ SLA adherence for compensation cycles
* Balance technical enablers (e.g., metadata, lineage, observability) with business\-driven features.

  

**4\. Data Exposure \& Consumption Strategy (Compensation\-Focused)**  

* Define product strategy for governed data exposure to:
* + Varicent
	+ BI \& reporting tools
	+ Finance systems
	+ Audit \& compliance teams
* Ensure compensation data is:
* + Securely shared
	+ Masked/tokenized where required
	+ Accessible through controlled semantic layers
* Enable analytics use cases such as:
* + Earnings forecasting
	+ Incentive plan performance analysis
	+ Sales performance insights
	+ Compensation cost modeling
* Define and track SLAs for compensation data availability during payout cycles.

  

**5\. Governance, Audit \& Compliance Alignment**  

  

Given the sensitive nature of compensation data:  

* Embed governance and audit principles into platform prioritization.
* Ensure support for:
* + Data lineage from source transaction to final payout
	+ Historical snapshotting and versioning
	+ Dispute investigation workflows
	+ Role\-based data access (field rep vs manager vs finance vs HR)
* Partner with InfoSec and compliance teams to enforce:
* + Encryption (at rest \& in transit)
	+ Zero\-trust access principles
	+ Data masking and tokenization
	+ Regulatory compliance requirements

  

**6\. Metrics \& Value Realization**  

  

Define and track KPIs such as:  

* Payout accuracy rate
* Compensation dispute volume
* Cycle time for compensation processing
* Data quality scores for ICP entities
* Platform uptime during compensation runs
* Adoption of standardized data models

  

Drive continuous improvements in compensation transparency and trust.  

  

**Required Skills \& Expertise**  

  

**Incentive Compensation Domain (Mandatory)**  

* Strong experience in **Incentive Compensation Planning (ICP)**.
* Deep understanding of:
* + Sales crediting logic
	+ Hierarchies and territory management
	+ Quota management
	+ Plan design structures
	+ Earnings calculations and payout processing
	+ Retro adjustments and audit requirements
* Experience working with compensation platforms such as **Varicent** (strongly preferred).
* Understanding of financial controls and audit needs related to compensation.

  

**Product \& Delivery Expertise**  

* 8\+ years of experience in Product Ownership / Product Management.
* Proven ownership of enterprise data or platform products.
* Strong Agile backlog management and roadmap planning expertise.
* Experience operating in cross\-functional enterprise environments.

  

**Data Platform \& Technical Understanding**  

  

Strong conceptual understanding of:  

* Medallion Architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold)
* Data Vault 2\.0 (Hubs, Links, Satellites)
* Lakehouse platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
* Batch and streaming architectures
* APIs and semantic layers
* Metadata, lineage, and observability frameworks
* Cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)

  

Strong data literacy (SQL proficiency preferred).  

  

**Security \& Governance Awareness**  

* IAM / RBAC best practices
* Data masking and encryption standards
* Secure data sharing frameworks
* Governance frameworks for regulated and financial\-sensitive data

  

**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience leading ICP transformations or compensation system migrations.
* Experience in Sales Performance Management (SPM) programs.
* CSPO / SAFe POPM certification.
* Experience in regulated or publicly traded enterprises.

  

**Leadership \& Behavioral Competencies**  

* Ability to translate complex compensation logic into scalable platform capabilities.
* Strong stakeholder management across Sales, Finance, HR, IT, and Architecture.
* High attention to detail and audit mindset.
* Strategic thinker with strong execution discipline.
* Ability to influence cross\-functional teams in matrixed organizations.

  

**Success Criteria**  

* Reliable and auditable ICP data platform supporting Varicent.
* Reduction in compensation disputes due to improved data transparency.
* Secure and governed compensation data exposure framework.
* Standardized modeling approach adopted across ICP domains.
* High stakeholder confidence in payout accuracy and traceability.

  

**About NTT DATA**  

  

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100\. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise\-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start\-up partners. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in\-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. description:
**About Rippling**
------------------


Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

  

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third\-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

  

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.4B\+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

  

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

**About the role**
------------------


As a Customer Support Manager at Rippling, you will lead a high\-performing team responsible for delivering exceptional support to our customers. You will act as the point of contact (POC) for all actions and domains within your team, ensuring efficient operations, seamless collaboration, and outstanding customer experiences. This role demands a proactive, strategic mindset combined with hands\-on leadership skills to drive team performance and process improvements in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.


You will report directly to the Senior Manager, Customer Support and play a pivotal role in aligning team goals with Rippling's broader objectives while focusing heavily on talent enablement and team development.

**What you will do**
--------------------

* Lead, mentor, and support team leads in their respective roles, fostering a culture of accountability and excellence.
* Provide coaching, constructive feedback, and professional development opportunities to team members.
* Handle team scheduling, attendance management, and adherence to ensure optimal staffing coverage.
* Drive the onboarding and development of early\-career employees, including campus hires and freshers.
* Design and implement scalable processes for issue resolution, SLA adherence, and escalation management.
* Monitor and analyze KPIs such as CSAT, Adherence, and ticket turnaround time.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including Tech, Product, and Operations, to address and resolve recurring or complex customer issues.
* Identify patterns in customer feedback and operational inefficiencies, providing actionable insights for process optimization.
* Train and mentor team members to enhance domain knowledge, improve problem\-solving capabilities, and deliver exceptional customer support.
* Analyze team performance data and trends to identify areas for improvement and implement solutions.
* Drive automation and system improvements to reduce manual interventions and improve accuracy.

**What you will need**
----------------------

* Experience: 6–9 years of experience in customer support or customer\-facing teams .
* Leadership Skills: Minimum 3–5 years of mandatory people management experience, with a proven ability to develop teams through coaching and performance management.
* Functional Must\-Haves: Hands\-on exposure to training or enablement programs and experience managing the development of early\-career cohorts (campus hires/freshers).
* Persona: High ownership, initiative, and a people\-oriented approach.
* Technical Proficiency: Familiarity with customer support platforms and HR or IT systems (preferred).
* Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills—clear, concise, and empathetic.
* Adaptability: Must\-have prior Night Shift experience \& Flexibility to work in US time zones and handle evolving priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Customer\-First Mindset: A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer experiences

 **NOTE**


Comfortable working in a hybrid office environment (3 days minimum) plus working US\-business hours (EST/PST time zones).

**Additional Information**
--------------------------


Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@rippling.com

  

Rippling highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. title: Outlet Manager
description:
**Job Title:** Outlet Manager

**Location:** Ahmedabad Airport

**About Us:** Zivaya is a chain of luxury wellness outlets major chains of hotels, palaces, airports and lounges across India. We offer premium therapies, beauty, spa \& hair treatments.

**Job Description:**

As an Outlet Manager, you will be responsible for the QUALITY \& REVENUE of the outlet. From describing our services to the consumer to ensuring that the place and staff looks tidy,collecting payments from the guests, and upselling services, you are required to take complete ownership of the outlet.

**Timings**\-while the outlet will run for 24 hours, and you will handle the main shift, as a manager, you will still be required to monitor the operations online at random times, and collect reports to ensure quality of our services. You might have to work in rotational shifts depending on the needs of the business. Your success will depend on how well you can make it run even in your absence. Any glitches and misses will still be your responsibility, as a manager.

**Quality**\-ensuring all systems and processes are implemented, all SOPs adhered to; deliver world\-class quality \& service, and achieve high customer satisfaction. This would involve completely managing operations\-handling appointments, hygiene, coordinating with outside agencies for support to avoid gaps in services. A detailed\-oriented approach will be needed to deliver an unmatched customer experience.

**Revenue**\-daily revenue collection \& booking in respective heads and reconciliation, achieve the targeted revenue by ensuring relevant branding at the outlet, and cross\-promotions with relevant brands and agencies inside the airport. As an outlet manager, you will be required to interact with the relevant customers inside the lounge to familiarize them with our services and offers; you will also have to maintain business relationships with major stakeholders at the airport that can help in the increase of guest inflow at the outlet.

**Experience**\-previous experience in customer service, guest engagement, sales and operations (hospitality, F\&B, aviation, banking, retail, beauty) preferred. Proven track\-record of achieving high guest satisfaction \& sales is a plus. Ability to handle conflicts within the team, and being able to constantly motivate them for high performance will be a key to success in this industry.

**Expectations**\-a highly disciplined individual with strong communication skills and a go\-getter attitude, ability to handle a team of 8\-10 people, strong work ethics and someone who can manage relationships across multiple departments. A strong preference will be given to anybody at airport bank/credit card retail sales who are used to reaching out to the audience for engagement.

A strong sense of **PROFESSIONALISM**. Due to the nature of the business and multiple\-stakeholders, we need strong candidates with strong integrity who might also be required to sign a document/cheque that might require the candidate to take full responsibility of cash \& revenue handling and its proper reconciliation. We prefer professional candidates who are non\-smokers.

**Growth**\-we offer strong visibility and opportunities of growth. This would come in the form of competitive compensation, incentives,freebies, and more.

title: Teacher- Digital Skills
description:
Akanksha is on a mission to build one of the largest and most innovative networks of schools in India, serving children from low\-income communities, to maximize their potential. Our aspirational vision for students integrates academic excellence with life skills (including socio\- emotional development), that will enable each child to live an empowered life. We believe an empowered citizen must possess a sense of mastery to pursue excellence, a sense of agency to make informed choices and a sense of purpose to serve their communities. Over the last 30 years, Akanksha has been at the forefront of proving what’s possible for children from low\-income communities in Mumbai \& Pune. Our 5,100 alumni are on the path to living an empowered life. Today Akanksha runs 26 schools in partnership with governments of Mumbai, Pune, Pimpri\-Chinchwad, Navi Mumbai and Nagpur serving \~14,000 children in grades Jr Kg \- Gr 10\.

**Position: Computer Teacher**

**Function/Team:** Akanksha

**School Location:** Seawoods (Navi Mumbai)

**Compensation:** Based on skill sets, experience and sector standards

**Reports to:** School Leader

**Position Summary:**

As an Akanksha teacher, you will be directly responsible for at least 40 kids in a class. Your role will be to guide the students toward academic achievement while inculcating self\-esteem and values in their curriculum that will empower them to think critically and make informed choices in their lives. You will cultivate an environment of high achievement coupled with fun learning in the classrooms. You will build strong bonds with children to understand each child’s needs and work with parents as partners in their child’s education and future. You will work with grades 3\-10 to implement our digital skills and computer science curriculum.

**Overview of the Team:**

The Akanksha Schools aim to be high\-quality schools serving children from low\-income communities in Mumbai . These schools work in partnership with local municipalities, with the vision of creating small clusters of model schools in these cities that can be used to impact the mainstream education system. The School Team comprises teachers, social workers, school administrator and helpers led by the School Leader.

**What your role will entail:**

● Teaching the Akanksha curriculum through effective pedagogical practices

● Designing and executing lesson plans that will engage students

● Designing assessments that thoughtfully evaluate student progress

● Varying teaching strategies and styles to meet different learning needs

● Providing a positive environment to engage students in the learning process

● Establishing and maintaining a co\-operative working relationships with students, parents, community and the school team

● Clearly articulating high expectations for students

● Creating and maintaining an aesthetically positive environment

● Actively participating in network opportunities for professional development

● Attending and participating in all school training and meetings

● Meeting professional obligations through efficient work habits

● Actively participating in all extra\-curricular and celebratory activities in school

● Making occasional community visits to stay connected with parents

● Observe other team members to learn more about the school culture, classroom management, content and skill execution

● Working collaboratively with the Digital Learning Core Team at Akanksha

● Coordinating with the School/IT team to set up and manage the required device infrastructure at the school

● Supporting schools and teachers to integrate digital skills in other subjects.

What you need for this Position

**Experience**

● Candidates with prior education/certification/experience in computer science / IT can apply

● Past teaching experience is preferred but freshers also encouraged to apply

**Education**

● BCS, MCS, BCA, MCA, B.Sc./MSc. in CS, B.Tech/MTech in CS are preferred.

● Graduates from other streams may also be considered provided with relevant experience in computer science / IT.

● B.Ed. preferred (not mandatory)

* Knowledge for Python ,C\+\+,Java and any other coding language good to have.

**Knowledge/Skills:**

● Strong content knowledge and expertise

● Love for children and learning

● Adaptability to new instructional approaches

● Patience and capacity to solve problems

● Good planning and organizing skills

● Strong team player

● Self\-motivated with strong work ethics to achieve school goals

● Openness to feedback and critical reflection

● Strong oral and written communication skills in English

● Sharp knowledge and understanding of computer science and digital skills

title: Monitoring Engineer
description:
Job Description – SER / SRE

Engineer (Monitoring Focus)

Role Overview

We are looking for an engineer who can own monitoring, observability, and

proactive reliability across our infrastructure. This role is not limited to alerting —

the expectation is to design, build, and act on monitoring systems end\-to\-end.

Key Responsibilities

Monitoring \& Observability

Design and implement end\-to\-end monitoring systems from scratch

Build and manage dashboards using Grafana

Configure and optimize Prometheus\-based monitoring

Implement logs monitoring using ELK / Loki

Set up telemetry and observability pipelines (metrics, logs, traces)

Alerting \& Proactive Detection

Design meaningful alerts (not noisy alerts)

Identify and troubleshoot:

CPU spikes

Memory leaks / RAM spikes

Disk I/O issues
