title: Director - HR Shared Services & Operations (Global ERC)
description:
Overview
  
Adobe is seeking a Director to lead its Global ERC operations, based in Bengaluru. This role is perfect for ambitious professionals looking to drive HR initiatives, ensuring flawless service delivery and innovation. You will be at the heart of Adobe's global HR strategy, working to successfully implement transformative projects that improve our global model and efficiency.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
Strategic Leadership \& Global Operations
  
Establish and complete the multi\-year global service delivery strategy aligned with enterprise HR and business priorities.
  
Own and evolve the Global ERC operating model, including governance, regional coverage, service scope, tiering model, and blocking issue frameworks.
  
Lead global transformation initiatives, such as establishing the strategic framework and governance model for contingent workforce operations beginning in India and growing globally.
  
Find opportunities to shift work strategically from Tier 1 to Tier 0 channels through automation, self\-service, and knowledge enablement.
  
Develop a culture of continuous improvement, bringing to bear process optimization, automation, and technology to improve scalability and employee experience.
  
People \& Organizational Leadership
  
Lead, develop, and encourage teams, building a strong bench and succession pipeline.
  
Foster a high\-performance, inclusive, and employee\-centric culture, championing diversity, equity, and inclusion.
  
Set clear expectations for performance, accountability, and behaviors; provide mentoring and feedback to team members.
  
Own workforce planning, capacity modeling, and skill development to support current and future business needs globally.
  
Collaborator Partnership \& Governance
  
Serve as the point of contact for complex, high\-risk, or sensitive employee matters involving blocking issues, ensuring appropriate resolution in partnership with COEs, Legal, and regional HR leaders.
  
Build strong, positive relationships with COEs, regional HR teams, and business leaders to align priorities, manage change, and deliver coordinated solutions.
  
Establish governance mechanisms to ensure compliance with global and local policies, regulatory requirements, and internal standards.
  
Represent Global ERC in senior leadership forums, providing clear updates on performance, risks, and central initiatives.
  
Operational Excellence \& Risk Management
  
Ensure robust documentation, controls, and audit readiness, including SOPs, process governance, and compliance reviews.
  
Identify operational risks and proactively implement mitigation strategies.
  
Lead large\-scale change initiatives (e.g., new systems, process redesigns, global rollouts), ensuring minimal disruption and strong adoption.
  
Skill \& Experience Requirements
  
15\+ years of progressive HR experience, with significant experience in global or multi\-region HR operations or shared services environments.
  
Demonstrated success in crafting and leading global transformation initiatives and scaling operating models across regions.
  
Strong critical thinking skills with the ability to translate vision into actionable plans and measurable outcomes.
  
Advanced collaborator management capabilities, with experience influencing senior leaders and navigating complex organizational dynamics.
  
Deep understanding of HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, case management, and HR technologies.
  
Proven ability to lead transformation, manage ambiguity, and inspire change in fast\-paced, global environments.
  
Outstanding communication abilities, enabling clear expression of strategy, performance, and risk to varied audiences.
  
Strong business insight, data proficiency, and experience building dashboards along with demonstrated decision\-making judgment.
  
Unwavering dedication to confidentiality, ethics, and employee trust.
  
About Adobe
  
Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.

At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.

Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture , focus on people, purpose and community , Adobe for All , comprehensive benefits programs , the stories we tell , the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
  
  

Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.

title: Manager, Business Intelligence
description:
Job description:

CACTUS is a remote\-first organization and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. However, given the business requirements of this role, you are expected to frequently travel to our Mumbai office/location office.  

CACTUS is looking for a **Manager** to lead high\-impact analytics and consulting initiatives in the higher education and research ecosystem. This role is ideal for a professional with experience working with **universities and academic institutions**, especially on **data audits, assessments, and strategic initiatives** focused on improving **research quality, research visibility, international collaboration, funding performance**, and related priorities. The candidate should create **innovative solutions** that address the evolving challenges of higher education, demonstrating skill in organising unclear issues into well\-defined analytical frameworks and actionable strategies.
The ideal candidate combines strong **analytical depth**, **consulting capability**, and **business judgment** with hands\-on expertise in **SQL, Power BI, Google BigQuery (GBQ), and Python**. This role requires translating large, complex datasets into **clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations** for both internal and external senior stakeholders.
Job responsibilities:
* Lead consulting projects for universities and research institutions, managing the full process from problem definition to executive presentations.
* Conduct data audits to evaluate the quality, completeness, and consistency of institutional data for benchmarking and reporting.
* Develop and deliver data\-driven recommendations and solutions, including dashboards and reports, to enhance process efficiency, reporting structures, metric visibility, and overall performance.
* Analyse digital performance data using digital analytics tools to identify opportunities for improving engagement, acquisition, and conversion across web and user journeys.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external clients to define business problems, create analytical frameworks, and deliver actionable recommendations aligned with market needs and institutional priorities.
* Synthesize complex analyses into executive\-ready presentations and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
* Ensure data quality, consistency, and reliability across all projects and reporting deliverables.
* Support business growth by contributing to solution development, proposals, and thought leadership in higher education and research intelligence.


Qualifications and prerequisites:
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Analytics, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, Business, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proven experience in **analytics consulting** roles, preferably with exposure to the higher education / university sector.
* Prior experience managing or contributing to engagements involving **university data audits, performance assessments, or strategic analytics initiatives**.
* Hands\-on expertise in:
* + **SQL**
	+ **Power BI (PBI)**
	+ **Google BigQuery (GBQ)**
	+ **Digital analytics**
* Strong experience in creating dashboards, KPI frameworks, and executive reporting for business or consulting use cases.
* Strong understanding of data validation, metric definitions, reporting structures, and governance best practices.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to present insights to senior stakeholders and non\-technical audiences.
* Experience managing client relationships and independently driving workstreams.


Application process:

Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process includes 2 rounds of technical interview, followed by the HR round.

 **Equal Opportunity**

  

Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.

 **Accelerating from Anywhere**


As a remote\-first organization, these are essential attributes we look for in all our candidates.

* Taking ownership of your work with minimal supervision, showing strong ability to organize, prioritize and deliver results independently.
* Documenting work that brings everyone on the same page.
* Maturity to choose between synchronous and asynchronous collaboration.
* Effectively collaborating with colleagues across different time zones by setting dedicated hours for collaboration and keeping team members updated through your MS Teams status.


About Us:

Established in 2002, Cactus Communications (cactusglobal.com) is a leading technology company that specializes in expert services and AI\-driven products which improve how research gets funded, published, communicated, and discovered. Its flagship brand Editage offers a comprehensive suite of researcher solutions, including expert services and cutting\-edge AI products like Mind the Graph, Paperpal, and R Discovery. With offices in Princeton, London, Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai, Seoul, Tokyo, and Mumbai and a global workforce of over 3,000 experts, CACTUS is a pioneer in workplace best practices and has been consistently recognized as a great place to work.
